fixed.problem: Review blocking 3: Add to it's brief lived only in memory while its plan was drafted. After a crash, the page said nothing ('none': no plan, no 'Planning failed', no Try again). After the app's Quit, the page showed 'Planning failed: planning was stopped before it finished.', or an older failure, and Try again drafted from the project's first brief. The old synchronous dialog had kept the brief and shown the error. The real-daemon case named 'a daemon closed while it drafts' only closed the daemon after the draft had finished.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'a daemon closed while the plan of an Add to brief is drafted: after a restart, twice, the page says it was not drafted and Try again drafts it from the same brief' (compose 2: received 'none', expected 'failed'). I checked it by putting the pre-fix intake.ts back.
fixed.how: IntakeService.enqueue now writes summary_cache.intake = {drafting_at, brief?} before the planning call and before the repository copy, for any draft from a brief (a draft with changes is left alone: its answered card keeps the changes). The write is draftRecord: one store transaction, read again on a version conflict, and it never throws. A filed card, or an open card that stands for the draft, removes the record (draftEnded, also called in proposeNow). A failure or a credential wait keeps the brief (recordFailure). status() answers 'failed' with DRAFT_LOST_WORDS when a record has drafting_at, no job of this daemon runs it, and no card was filed after it. DRAFT_LOST_WORDS is 'Forerunner closed before the plan from your brief was drafted.' (session/intake-words.ts). The banner then reads 'Planning failed: Forerunner closed before the plan from your brief was drafted.' with Try again, and a project with no tasks gets the planning_failed line with Try again. retry() drafts from the kept brief. In the test, the stand-in holds the planning call until the daemon is gone; after two restarts it asserts the status, the banner line, the project line and that no card exists; then Try again drafts from the brief (not from the first one) and files one card, and a further restart reads pending. The misnamed earlier case is renamed and now asserts the one card exactly.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live check. Make a project here on a repository with a brief. Then New project on the same repository with a different brief, press Add to it, and the page says 'Drafting the plan from your brief…'. Quit Forerunner from the tray and open it again: the project page says 'Planning failed: planning was stopped before it finished.' with Try again. Press Try again: the plan card in the Inbox is planned from the Add to brief (its tasks fit that brief, not the first one). Repeat, but end the process in Task Manager while it drafts: the page says 'Planning failed: Forerunner closed before the plan from your brief was drafted.' with Try again, and Try again drafts from the Add to brief.

new_problems: The app's Quit (POST /shutdown, kill.stop("all", QUIT_REASON)) stops the planning call before the store closes. The page after a Quit therefore reads 'Planning failed: planning was stopped before it finished.', not the crash sentence; this is the 'killed' words of intakeFailureWords, which cannot tell a Quit from Stop now. Bench evidence: scratchpad/b3walk/after.log. The brief is kept and Try again works either way. Whether a Quit should read 'Forerunner closed before the plan from your brief was drafted.' is a words choice for the session lead.

Pre-existing, not caused by this branch: Change the plan, and Reject followed by Draft a new plan, on a plan drafted from an Add to brief still draft from the project's first brief. A filed card does not keep its brief. proposeNow uses opts.brief ?? summary_cache.brief; Change the plan's enqueue (intake.ts, the 'changed' answer) passes only {changes, read}; retry from 'rejected' passes {}. A fix would keep the brief on the card (change_card.brief) and draft from it.

The stand-in's plan does not depend on the brief, so on the bench the right brief shows only in the model-call log, never on the card. The live check should confirm the card's tasks fit the Add to brief.

Suggested CHANGELOG/UPDATE-LOG line (not edited here): 'A plan Add to it drafts in the background survives a Quit or a crash: the project page says it was not drafted, with Try again, and Try again (or the draft after a Claude limit) uses the brief you gave, not the project's first one.'
notes_for_other_areas: summary_cache.intake now also holds drafting_at (ISO; written by IntakeService.enqueue before the planning call for a draft from a brief, removed once a card is filed) and brief (the brief a background draft was given; kept with failed_at/error/wait on a failure or a wait). Only IntakeService reads it (status, retry). w8-status-read: the GitHub read you add before planning in the background path runs after this record is written, so a failure or Quit during it is said and retried the same way. Use draftRecord/draftEnded, never a plain overwrite of summary_cache.intake.

New sentence: DRAFT_LOST_WORDS = 'Forerunner closed before the plan from your brief was drafted.' (packages/runtime/src/session/intake-words.ts); the banner reads 'Planning failed: Forerunner closed before the plan from your brief was drafted.' and the project line reads 'Planning failed: Forerunner closed before the plan from your brief was drafted' with Try again.

packages/runtime/test/credential-limits.test.ts world() now also returns scripted (the ScriptedProvider behind the Messages API stand-in) so a test can read what a credential-served call asked.
